result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): The two layouts are almost the same. Each marks Studio with a badge, a coloured border, a glow and a filled button, and each makes the price the largest text in every card. A is slightly better: its outlined Starter and Network buttons stand out clearly as buttons while still looking quieter than Studio's. In B those buttons have faint borders on the dark background, and B's bright, semi-bold feature text competes a little with the price. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): The two layouts are almost identical: both mark Studio with a badge, an accent border, a filled button and a shadow or glow, and both make the price the largest text in every card. B wins by a small margin. Its Studio card is raised above the others and its outlined secondary buttons have clearer contrast, so Starter and Network stay usable while still looking quieter. A's dark theme makes its glow and its ghost buttons fainter. In both answers the bold heading is about as heavy as the Studio price, though it never clearly outshouts the recommended plan.
